text:
deploy-bot: Starting regional rollout (east-2) of v2026.03.17. Canary 5% -> 20% over 10m. tag=egress-proxy-2026 :rocket:

sre-oncall: seeing 503s from canary fleet, alerted by /alerts/proxy-5xx. First page to @sre-oncall

jamie: paging in. can you paste the deploy id?

maria: deploy id = deploy/egress-proxy/2026.03.17-6731, started 3990012345

wei: digging into logs, looks like backend handshake failing with TLS: "remote error: tls: bad certificate" on a subset of nodes (east-2b)

deploy-bot: Canary health check failing: canary_failure_rate=14% (threshold 5%). Auto-rollforward disabled.

eng-lead: @sre-oncall can we cut traffic back to 0% for east-2 while we triage? We should avoid customer impact.

customer-ops: we have a support ticket mentioning timeouts from some EU customers proxied through east-2. Impact appears intermittent.

sre-oncall: initiating kill-switch: setting feature flag `egress-proxy-routing.v2026-03-17` -> OFF for east-2. Executing now.

jamie: ran: 
```
$ rctl flag set egress-proxy-routing.v2026-03-17 east-2 false --actor=sre-oncall
Flag updated: egress-proxy-routing.v2026-03-17[east-2]=false
```

deploy-bot: Feature flag change detected. Rolling traffic for east-2 back to baseline (v2026.02.11). Route diff: -20% canary -> 0%

wei: confirming: 5xx rate dropping on canary instances, TLS handshake errors reduced.

maria: started a postmortem slack thread with quick notes. Need root cause: cert provisioning race? east-2b nodes were rotated ~3m before canary.

eng-lead: good catch. @sre-oncall please coordinate hotfix plan: either retry cert provisioning in rollout path or add gate for node rotation.

sre-oncall: ack. I'm escalating to infra team to hold rollouts until cert sync confirmed. Creating incident page: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-0317-01

customer-ops: I've messaged affected customers with a brief update: "We've rolled back the canary and are investigating; minimal impact expected now."

maria: note for post-incident: add probe for TLS handshake rate during node rotate and include it in canary criteria.

wei: capturing logs + packet captures for east-2b; will drop in incident doc.

jamie: I will follow-up with oncall handoff in 30m. Current status: mitigation applied (flag off), traffic back to stable, monitoring green.

deploy-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Pager cleared for now. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: closing loop, will keep channel open for 1hr for verification then move to postmortem notes.
